title: Lease Term Agreement Concession Recapture Amount — Calculation Worksheet
content:
The concession recapture on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement is the total of the rent concession credits posted on the lease ledger, multiplied by the full months from the requested termination date to the term end date and divided by the term's months, rounded half up to the cent.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Concession total | The rent concession credits posted on the Apartment Home Lease ledger, added together |
| Requested termination date | The termination date asked for on the open lease-break request (the most recently submitted lease-break request of the term) |
| Term end date and term's months | The terminating Lease Term Agreement |
| Unearned months | The full calendar months from the requested termination date to the term end date |

## Calculation

The unearned concession is the concession total multiplied by the unearned months and divided by the term's months, and no figure before the final one is rounded. The recapture is that figure rounded half up to the cent: an amount reaching half a cent, or falling short of half a cent by no more than 0.0001 cents, is rounded up to the next cent, and any other amount is rounded down.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A 12-month term running from 15 March to 14 March of the next year; rent concession credits of 600.00 and 600.00 dollars on the lease ledger; an open lease-break request for a termination date of 20 September.

1. Concession total: 1,200.00 dollars.
2. Unearned months: from 20 September to 14 March is 5 full calendar months (the sixth would be complete only on 20 March).
3. Unearned concession: 1,200.00 multiplied by 5 is 6,000.00; divided by 12 is 500.00.
4. Recapture: 500.00 dollars.

With a concession total of 1,000.00 dollars and the same dates, 1,000.00 multiplied by 5 and divided by 12 is 416.666…, rounded half up to 416.67 dollars.
